ambiguity.bin_definition: ratio-specific entropy tertiles estimated on the 30-user discovery test cohort

history_size.bin_definition: tertiles estimated across users in the 30-user discovery cohort

parameter_rationale.neighbors: k=10 is the primary local-history neighbourhood; k=5 and k=20 are prespecified half/double sensitivity values. No k is selected from held-out performance.
parameter_rationale.ambiguity_bins: Discovery-derived ratio-specific tertiles give interpretable low, medium, and high strata without using held-out outcome values.
parameter_rationale.history_bins: Discovery-derived user tertiles avoid choosing held-out cut points after inspecting method effects.
parameter_rationale.bootstrap: The replicate count matches the primary experiment; the seed is fixed before the new analyses are run.
